name: HME Specialists
old_description: I have been using oxygen since 2001 and have been with other providers until last year. The service I have received from HME has bee far superior to other companies. Every HME person I have dealt with, whether in person, or over the phone, has bee professional, courteous and most of all helpful.
about:
HME Specialists was founded in 2001 in Santa Fe, New Mexico, by four New Mexicans who wanted to build a different kind of medical equipment company. Their vision was to create a local supplier offering the same breadth of equipment as national chains but with a higher standard of personalized service.

The company provides a range of home medical equipment and services, including home oxygen therapy, breast pumps, sleep therapy (CPAP/BiPAP), home infusion therapy, enteral nutrition, wound care, and incontinence and urology supplies. A clinical team of pharmacists, registered nurses, assistive technology professionals (ATPs), and respiratory therapists coordinates with patients' insurance carriers and healthcare providers to deliver equipment and supplies directly to the home. HME Specialists describes itself as New Mexico's largest local medical equipment and supply company.

Its customers are primarily patients requiring respiratory support, infusion therapy, nutritional support, or wound management, as well as the healthcare providers and insurers who authorize that care. Testimonials reference long-term oxygen users, CPAP patients transitioning equipment, hospice patients needing urgent DME delivery, and families managing tracheostomy care at home.

The founders' stated purpose was to offer a local alternative to national suppliers with more personalized service. The company's mission is to help each patient reach their highest level of medical independence by delivering equipment and services seamlessly with exceptional care, and it emphasizes community involvement through partnerships with organizations such as the American Lung Association and the American Heart Association.
